messages:
sophie: Quick heads-up — Havenly wants a POC next week. Goal: sustained 120 qps per region, avg request ~256 tokens, 99th tail <300ms, multi-region active/passive failover. They also sent a security questionnaire (KMS details). Can we get an ops runbook + rough cost delta hosted vs dedicated? cc @jules @raj

raj: Thanks. For sustained 120 qps at ~256 tokens we need the exact model variant and whether batching is allowed. Which model did they request?

sophie: They asked for a privacy-forward quantized model: "redwood-ggml-large-q4". Preference is Private deployment but open to Dedicated if it's cheaper/safer. They flagged KMS per-request latency as a blocker.

jules: Plan outline: 1) smoke 0->50 qps, 2) ramp 50->120 over 20m, 3) 4h soak at 120 qps capturing p50/p90/p99, 4) 30m spike to 240 qps to validate headroom. Run primary us-west1, failover eu-west1. Ops to run.

matt: Ops nuts-and-bolts: set request timeout 5s, max concurrency per worker 8, enable KV prefix caching, sample traces at 1%. We'll also capture cold-start counts per model variant.

raj: Note on quantized variant: memory lower but kernel latency can be more variable at long sequences. Recommend we test both q4 and fp16 for comparison. Dedicated sizing: an 8-GPU pool (A100 equiv) should give comfortable headroom for 120 qps with batching.

security-bot: New security questionnaire added by Havenly — https://redwood-internal/secure/q/HVN-2026-09 (KMS, SOC2, data residency).

sophie: POC asks also need a quick pricing stub: cost/day hosted vs pro-rated dedicated during the soak. Ballpark is fine for sales deck.

jules: Ballpark calc (very rough): hosted (quantized): ~$650/day for 120 qps soak (includes infra + request units). Dedicated (pro-rated test): equivalent to ~$230/day + egress and KMS calls. I'll validate numbers with finance.

raj: Load agent snippet for the run (k6):
```
k6 run --vus 60 --duration 4h --rps 120 script.js
# script.js uses batching=1, prompt_len=256
```
Ensure latency per-token and per-response percentiles are recorded.

matt: Ops checklist for execution:
- provision nodes in us-west1 and eu-west1
- enable KV cache + warm before soak
- enable trace sampling 1% and perf metrics export
- prepare fallback smaller model and automatic reroute policy
I'll schedule tomorrow 08:00 PT.

sophie: Can someone confirm KMS behavior? Havenly is worried about decrypt on each request (they use envelope keys).

jules: We use envelope encryption in Private/Dedicated: KMS decrypt occurs at keywrap/until the DEK is cached; not per user request. We'll document sequence and put a diagram in the security response. Security should verify but it's not per-request decrypt.

matt: I'll add a smoke that toggles key rotation and measures the handshake impact. Also will surface any additional HSM latency in logs.

sophie: Great. Can we have the final runbook + cost stub by EOD so I can send to Havenly?

raj: Will post runbook, exact GPU sizing, and perf caveats here by 17:00 PT.

ops-bot: Run scheduled: 2026-04-05T08:00:00Z, run id: run-HVN-77 (assigned to matt).
